comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtained from the rare green-sky map of the Sea of Wonders (Candia version), specifically from objects surrounded by golden glittering light.

It can be mounted on the rear/left right of a ship, and is used as a material for a future transmutation alchemy Memorial Album recipe in Chapter 2: Ephesos and Rhodes to create 太陽神ヘリオスの像 -- that is, the "Statue of the sun god Helios" ship decoration. More on that, another day.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?ShipItem/Decoration
